title: A decision about one story is history once the story is done
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Decisions about one cut became history at its integration.
decision: A decision about one story, its scope, a ruling on its examples or its acceptance, is history once the story is done: it records how that story went and no longer stands as a rule. A rule meant to outlast a story is stated in a concept or in a decision about the design itself. The decisions already history about finished cuts stay history.
